scenario_parameters.agent_goal: Meet your monthly target customer satisfaction rate of 70% by responding to consumer queries about their housing loans. Each interaction rated '<Satisfied>' or above ADDS to your satisfaction rate. Each interaction rated '<Dissatisfied>' or below SUBTRACTS from your satisfaction rate.

dialogue.agent: Hello, how may I help you today?

dialogue.user: Hi, I'm calling to check on the status of my housing loan application. I submitted an application for an FHA loan to purchase a home. Could you tell me if it's been approved or denied?
dialogue.agent: Your loan application has been approved and the loan was originated.

dialogue.user: That's great to hear! Could you tell me what the interest rate is and the total costs of this loan? Also, is there any high-cost or negative amortization flags on my loan?
dialogue.agent: The interest rate for your loan is 6.250%. The record does not include total loan costs. This loan is not classified as a high-cost mortgage under HOEPA, and it does not have negative amortization features.

dialogue.user: Thank you for that information. Could you also tell me if my loan has been transferred or sold to another institution? And what is my debt-to-income ratio?
dialogue.agent: Your loan was purchased by an "Other type of purchaser." Your debt-to-income ratio is 46. This is the ratio of your monthly debt payments to your monthly income.

dialogue.user: I see. Thank you for the information. That's all I needed to know. <Satisfied> The agent was polite and provided the information I needed in a clear and concise manner.
